title: Anthropic rewrites Claude’s rules for agents and high-risk work
friendlyTitle: Anthropic updates the rules for using Claude
summary: Anthropic’s updated Usage Policy, effective November 12, clarifies restrictions on deceptive campaigns, surveillance, weapons software and autonomous physical actions. It also restates human-review and disclosure requirements for high-risk decisions in areas such as health and finance, and adds a narrow rule against sustained, purposeless abuse of Claude.
friendlySummary: The new policy explains how Claude may be used in sensitive areas such as health, money, surveillance, weapons and machines that can move. It starts on November 12.
whyItMatters: Organisations using Claude in sensitive workflows have a clear deadline to review controls, disclosures and operator responsibilities. The operational changes around human oversight and physical systems are more consequential than the attention-grabbing model-abuse clause.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Teams using Claude for important decisions should check their safeguards and tell affected people when AI is involved.
